meta.title: Listed-peer market scoreboard — SET market value, valuation & returns (obj #2)
meta.label: MEASURED — Stock Exchange of Thailand (autonomous pull). Market cap/valuation as of the price date; ROE/net profit/assets from the latest quarterly filing. NOT an AutoX figure — AutoX is unlisted, so its 25% ROE TARGET is shown only as the reference line.
meta.source: Stock Exchange of Thailand · set.or.th in-browser JSON API (highlight-data + profile + company-highlight/financial-data)
meta.roe_caveat: ROE is each peer's own SET-reported ratio; TIDLOR's holding-company structure inflates its reported ROE relative to MTC/SAWAD, so read the ladder with that caveat and compare net profit + market cap directly.

headline: Listed rivals total ฿169bn of market value; Muangthai Capital is the largest at ฿70.5bn. Ngern Tid Lor leads share momentum this year (+14.7% YTD).
